messages:
alisa: Noticing a cluster of small GPU tasks Pending then evicted in eu-west2 at 04:12 UTC. ~30 tiny-pod evictions in 30m.

matt: Any rollouts or kubelet changes?

alisa: No control-plane changes. Node logs show attach/lease timeouts and NVLINK resets around the same time. Heartbeat p95 jumped.

sangeeta: Autoscaler and scheduler metrics confirm node-heartbeat p95 spiked from 200ms->5s at 04:10. Scheduler avoided those nodes, scattering tiny pods. Backfill preempted the scattered ones.

devon: Snippet from logs:
```
I0421 04:11:58 kube-scheduler: binding pod foo: lease timeout
I0421 04:12:03 kube-scheduler: fallback bind -> node-2
I0421 04:12:07 node-1: nvlink link-reset
I0421 04:12:15 eviction-controller: evicting pod foo due to preempt
```

opsbot: Alert: evictions-eu-west2 increased. Incident INC-5280 created.

matt: Short-term: canary a scheduler profile in one AZ that increases leaseGrace to 25s, introduces nodeRecoveryCooldown 60s, and reduces tiny-pod backfill sensitivity.

sangeeta: +1. Add Grafana panels for tiny-pod eviction by AZ and heartbeat p50/p95 to monitor rollback window.

alisa: Spinning a 50-node canary pool in eu-west2b and applying profile now.

opsbot: Deploy job started: scheduler-profile -> canary-eu-west2b (job-7012).

devon: Config diff:
leaseGracePeriod: "25s"
nodeRecoveryCooldown: "60s"
backfillTinyPodWeight: "0.35"

matt: If canary reduces evictions, next steps: deeper NVLINK investigation (driver/firmware), and consider smoothing logic in placement so tiny-gang stickiness tolerates short heartbeats.

alisa: Canary applied. Monitoring for 30m. Will report metrics. :eyes:
